facebook.caption: This place fixes burnout. Công Viên Bạch Đằng sits right beside the famous Dinh Cậu rock temple, where the sea opens up on both sides and the wind just hits different. No entrance fee. No crowds at sunrise. Just fishing boats, salt air, and the kind of quiet Phu Quoc doesn't advertise. Walk the waterfront, watch the offerings at the temple, then grab a coffee from a nearby cart. Zero agenda required. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Camera pans the waterfront at Công Viên Bạch Đằng. Boats. Wind. Dinh Cậu temple on the rock behind you. No tour group in sight. This is the version of Phu Quoc most people walk straight past.
